authoritative_identity.identity_rule: The exact strategy file bytes at this SHA-256 define the strategy. If the workspace path has a different hash, resolution must fail closed rather than silently accepting the changed file.
authoritative_identity.origin_rule: This is the SuperMind V6 code supplied directly by the user. Do not search for, infer, or substitute another purported original implementation.

frozen_definition.universe: The literal 152-code ETF pool embedded in the authoritative strategy source, intersected causally with the platform's effective ETF security list.
frozen_definition.eligibility: At least 121 valid closes and prior-20 average turnover of at least CNY 20,000,000.
frozen_definition.entry_environment: CSI1000 000852.SH close relative to MA15 controls permission for new entries only.
frozen_definition.entry_structure: ETF official close above its own MA20 and above the previous 60-session high, after FULL40 contraction: prior-40 box width no more than 12.5%, prior-day MA5/10/20/30 dispersion no more than 5%, direction efficiency no more than 0.40, and prior vol10/vol60 no more than 0.90.
frozen_definition.volume_location: HARD MINVOLLOC30: the minimum-volume session in the prior 30 sessions must lie at or below 0.50 of that price window's low-to-high location.
frozen_definition.ranking: Equal-weight cross-sectional percentile ranks of 20-, 60-, and 120-session momentum across the full eligible ETF cross-section; deterministic mom60 and code tie-breaks are preserved from source.
frozen_definition.portfolio: Maximum five holdings. CAP50_SET resizes to min(50%, 1/N) only when target membership changes. A full portfolio is not rank-replaced merely because a new ETF has a higher RS score.
frozen_definition.own_exit: An ETF exits after two consecutive completed closes below its contemporaneous MA40, with sticky retry semantics until liquidation succeeds.
frozen_definition.market_exit: 510300.SH retains portfolio-level weekly MA20 liquidation and the separate daily 2% below-MA20 emergency liquidation under BOTH mode.
frozen_definition.execution: Preserve the source's official-close signal formation, next-session opening entry, tail sell, trading-status, fill retry, and no-same-bar-entry semantics. A signal formed on bar t cannot enter inside bar t.

interpretation: A long-only ETF compression-to-ignition strategy: identify low-volatility equilibrium and low-position supply exhaustion, require a confirmed 60-session breakout, select persistent relative-strength leaders, and avoid prematurely truncating the trend right tail.
not_the_same_as: Any sixth/seventh-position overlay or RS-threshold expansion
Any dynamic or expanded ETF-universe V7 research variant
Any version that changes FULL40, MINVOLLOC30, B60, market gates, exits, CAP50_SET, T+1, or real-executability semantics
scientific_warning: Local hybrid replay evidence is shadow evidence and does not establish exact native SuperMind/QMT fill equivalence. The registered name identifies strategy semantics and exact source bytes; it does not upgrade data lineage, validation status, or live-trading authorization.
